snippet.title: Spire of Chaos: Arcana Unleashed | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Spire of Chaos: Arcana Unleashed will come April 10th 2026.

Spire of Chaos: Arcana Unleashed is a FREE 3D souls-lite action game where you play as Arxis, a magical girl linked to the Tower, the source of her chaotic power and one of the most feared arcana of the Tarot.

Wishlist on Steam now : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4140180/Spire_of_Chaos__Arcana_Unleashed/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/spireofchaos/

#indiegame #studentdevelopment #soulslike #actionadventure #uqat #comingsoon
